headline: The Select Board set an estimated FY27 property tax rate of $14.54 while previewing a projected $1.4 million FY28 budget deficit.
synopsis: The Select Board voted 4-1 to maintain a single property tax rate for FY27, raising the average single-family tax bill by $713 to $14,944. Town officials also presented an early look at the FY28 operating budget, warning of a $1.4 million deficit under level-service funding that would require a Proposition 2 1/2 operating override. Meanwhile, the Planning Board heard substantial resident traffic concerns regarding the proposed Costco warehouse, and the Capital Improvement and Planning Committee reviewed major multi-year public works capital requests.

highlights.title: FY27 tax classification hearing and tax rate
highlights.why: The Select Board approved a single tax rate of $14.54 per $1,000 of valuation, increasing the average single-family residential tax bill by 5.01 percent, while rejecting residential and commercial exemptions.

highlights.title: FY28 operating budget preview and override options
highlights.why: Town administration outlined an early $1.4 million levy limit deficit for FY28 under a level-service budget, which would require a Proposition 2 1/2 override or significant departmental service and staffing reductions.

highlights.title: 21 Coslin Drive (Costco Wholesale) traffic study
highlights.why: Board members and neighbors challenged traffic modeling and regional cut-through truck impacts for the proposed 167,000-square-foot warehouse, continuing the hearing to November 16.

highlights.title: DPW and Water FY28 capital requests and multi-year plan
highlights.why: The DPW detailed major multi-year capital needs, including $1.82 million for smart water meters, $700,000 for state-mandated water tank rehabilitation, and $823,000 in potential soil cleanup costs.

highlights.title: Fayville Park state grant and parking design
highlights.why: Southborough was awarded a $631,350 state grant to fund half of proposed park improvements, with full project implementation contingent on Community Preservation Committee and Town Meeting votes.

looking_ahead.what: Neary School Building Committee briefing from project architect on preferred design and cost estimates
Continued public hearing on 21 Coslin Drive (Costco Wholesale) covering civil engineering and traffic
Select Board meeting with Schools K-8, DPW, Police, and Fire on FY28 budget scenarios
Select Board review of departmental budget memos and meetings with additional department heads
